lessons.title: Tickets and transfers

notes.title: Grammar in this lesson
notes.pattern: Nの切符 / Nで乗り換えます / Nの料金
notes.explanation: 往復 is a round trip; 片道 one way. 回数券 is a set of tickets for several journeys or uses. 乗り換え is a transfer between services. 乗り越し means traveling beyond the station covered by your ticket or intended journey. 気づく means notice or realize, with に marking what you notice. だけ limits the scope: 片道だけ means only one direction.

lessons.title: At the station

notes.title: Word usage
notes.pattern: Nで待ちます / Nに乗車します / Nで下車します
notes.explanation: 改札 is ticket checking or, in everyday station use, the ticket gate. プラットホーム is the platform. 車掌 is a train conductor. 乗車 means boarding or riding a train, bus or similar vehicle; 下車 getting off. These are common in announcements. に marks the vehicle boarded; で the station where you get off.

lessons.title: Meeting up and drawing near

notes.title: Word usage
notes.pattern: Nに集合します / Nに近づきます
notes.explanation: 集合 is an arranged gathering or meeting up. に marks the meeting place. 近づく means approach or draw near; it can describe a vehicle nearing a place or a time getting closer. In the latter use, the approaching time takes が.

notes.title: Word usage
notes.pattern: Nに停車します / N方面 / 発車まで

lessons.title: Railways and routes

notes.title: Word usage
notes.pattern: Nを通過します / Nが開通します / Nの線路
notes.explanation: 私鉄 is a privately operated railway, and モノレール a monorail. 線路 is railway track. 開通 is the opening of a route to traffic. 鉄橋 is a railway bridge or an iron bridge. 通過 means pass through or pass by without stopping; を marks the place passed through.

lessons.title: Understanding a route

notes.title: Word usage
notes.pattern: Nを経由します / N経由のバス
notes.explanation: 経由 describes going by way of an intermediate place. を marks that place with 経由する. In 空港経由のバス, the airport comes before 経由 and の links the route description to the bus. A place on the route is not necessarily your final destination.

Here it means accompanying someone to departure, not its other sense of putting off a decision.
